title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Hosea 12: Ephraim feeding on wind, Jacob at Bethel, dishonest scales and a call to turn back.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say Ephraim feeds on?
questions.explanation: Ephraim feeds on wind and chases the east wind, and continually multiplies lies and desolation.

questions.text: With whom does Yahweh have a controversy, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has a controversy with Judah and will punish Jacob according to his ways.

questions.text: What does verse 3 say Jacob did in the womb?
questions.explanation: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

answers.text: He cried out for a blessing
He took his brother by the heel

questions.text: According to verse 4, where did he find him after struggling with the angel?
questions.explanation: He struggled with the angel and prevailed, he wept and made supplication, and he found him at Bethel.

questions.text: What does verse 6 tell them to keep?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says to turn to your God, keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

questions.text: What does a merchant have in his hand, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand, and he loves to defraud.

questions.text: What did Ephraim say about himself in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Ephraim said that he had become rich and found himself wealth, and that in all his wealth no sinful iniquity would be found in him.

answers.text: That he was poor and oppressed
That he had become rich and found wealth
That he had kept the whole law
That he would turn back to God

questions.text: What does God say he will make them dwell in again?
questions.explanation: God, who is Yahweh their God from the land of Egypt, says he will again make them dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

questions.text: By whom did Yahweh bring Israel up out of Egypt, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

questions.text: What will his Lord repay, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger, so his blood will be left on him and his Lord will repay his contempt.
